summary: Sprott Physical Gold & Silver Trust filed a Form 6-K containing its interim management report of fund performance and unaudited financial statements for the period ended March 31, 2026. The filing is a routine periodic report required for foreign private issuers. It discusses investment objectives, risks, and results of operations including unrealized and realized gains on bullion holdings. The Trust issued units under an at-the-market program but no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is disclosed. The content is purely operational and financial performance reporting.
